title: Contractor license lookup
description: One state per run. Provide a license number, a business name, a trade, or a combination. CAPTCHA states return a status row and are not billed.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter state code. CA reads the CSLB open file. AZ, NJ, and PA are adapters that stop when the source is a challenge or a closed portal.

licenseNo.title: License number
licenseNo.description: Board license or registration number. Matched exactly, ignoring spaces and leading zeros.

name.title: Business name
name.description: Business name. Punctuation and company suffixes such as LLC are ignored. Combined with the license number and trade when more than one is set.

trade.title: Trade or class
trade.description: Classification code (B-1 and B1 match) or a class description such as Roofing. A trade-only search returns at most maxResults rows.

maxResults.title: Max licenses
maxResults.description: Cap on found licenses pushed for this run. Default 25, maximum 50. Extra matches are not billed.

maxRequests.title: Max HTTP requests
maxRequests.description: Cap including robots.txt. CA needs 2. AZ needs up to 3 when the posting page is served. Default 4, maximum 8.

delaySeconds.title: Delay between requests
delaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before each request after the first. Default 2.

headless.title: Headless browser
headless.description: Kept for the shared Actor contract. This Actor does not launch a browser.
